title: fix(messaging): the approval Slack DM links the Console page under its mount
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBJd5Bh7CVK9Jm81ZRGXLohp)_

Fixes #36301

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzjF6c6pWoGHX3bWhw9

The card's claim naming this branch is comment 7099292948 on #36301.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 审批人在 Slack 私信里点「审批请求」的链接，修前打开的是「找不到」页面，修后直接进入控制台里那条审批。
- 属于「审批收尾」专题：邮件里的同一个链接上一轮已修好，这次补上 Slack 私信这一路。
- 出错的话只影响私信里那一个链接的地址；审批本身、站内收件箱和邮件都不受影响，撤回这次改动即恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

`packages/services/service-messaging` only.

- `slack-channel.ts`: a relative `actionUrl` is a Console route, so the DM link is now made absolute under `origin + Console mount` instead of `origin` alone. A module-internal `consoleLinkBase(origin, composer)` reads the mount from the auth service's Console page composer (`getConsoleUrl`, i.e. `AuthConfig.uiBasePath`), takes only the composer's PATH, strips any base path it shares with the origin (so a sub-path deployment is not prefixed twice — the same rule as plugin-approvals `consolePageLink`), and falls back to no mount when there is no composer, it answers nothing, throws, or answers a non-URL. No origin ⇒ no link, as before. The composer rides on a module-internal `SlackChannelWiring` taken by a module-internal `mountSlackChannel`; the published `createSlackChannel` delegates to it with the public options, which are unchanged, as are `slackDmText` / `absoluteLink`. An absolute `actionUrl` is sent as it is.
- `messaging-service-plugin.ts`: mounts the channel through `mountSlackChannel` with `getConsoleUrl` read from the `auth` service per delivery (the same lazy reader plugin-approvals and plugin-audit use).
- Package entry unchanged: `index.ts` is byte-identical to `origin/main`, `SlackChannelOptions` is byte-identical, and the built `dist/index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` carry zero hits for `consoleLinkBase`, `getConsoleUrl`, `ConsolePageComposer`, `mountSlackChannel`, `SlackChannelWiring`. Hence `Clause-②: no` (L1 M1, comment 7101086524).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-messaging` patch.

No new package edge: `service-messaging` does not import `plugin-approvals` (the mount rule is restated locally, with a pointer to `consolePageLink`), and `plugin-approvals` is untouched — its producer keeps `actionUrl` relative (`/system/approvals?request=ID`), which the in-app inbox needs.

## Tests

- `slack-channel.test.ts` — new block "the deep link under the Console mount": the posted approval DM text carries `/_console/`; custom `uiBasePath` and `/`; sub-path origin not prefixed twice; the composer's origin is ignored; no / empty / throwing / non-URL composer ⇒ no mount; no origin ⇒ no base.
- `slack-channel-composition.test.ts` — new block through `MessagingServicePlugin` itself: with an auth service exposing `getConsoleUrl`, the mounted channel posts the link under `/_console`; with one that has none, the link is unchanged (control).
- Ablation (committed fix, on-disk mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD blob each time):
  - `slack-channel.ts` send path back to the bare origin ⇒ 2 failed / 19 passed (the unit send pin and the composition pin).
  - plugin wiring without `getConsoleUrl` ⇒ 1 failed / 20 passed (the composition pin); re-run after the rework on `mountSlackChannel`, same 1 failed / 20 passed, restored to the HEAD blob.

<details><summary>Local runs (head 65fe2ea87)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging build` then `typecheck` ⇒ exit 0; `test` ⇒ Test Files 80 passed (80), Tests 1090 passed (1090) (on fc521e143; 65fe2ea87 changes three docblocks only, slack tests re-run there: 21 passed).
- Derived gate families on 65fe2ea87 (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 73 derived, 73 run, all exit 0; `--ran`: "73 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- First round (edff20ff0): same package suite and 73/73 gates green; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its fixture commit fetched on the shallow clone (exit 3 before, 0 after).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Reuse for #35844** (p3, origin source; outside this PR): the mount rule lives in one function, `consoleLinkBase(origin, composer)` in `slack-channel.ts`, whose origin is the caller's. #35844 can hand the approvals' `publicBaseUrl` in through the existing `getPublicOrigin` option and keep this mount rule unchanged; nothing in this PR changes which origin the DM uses.
- A host that builds the channel itself with the published `createSlackChannel` (rather than registering `MessagingServicePlugin`) keeps the link it got before; widening the published options to carry the composer would be a Clause-② change and is left out by L1 ruling M1.
- The sub-path rule is restated in `service-messaging` rather than shared with plugin-approvals `consolePageLink`, because neither package depends on the other and the order forbids a new edge. If a shared home is wanted later, it is a lower package both already import (`@objectstack/types`); noted, not filed.
- Every relative `actionUrl` a Slack DM carries now goes under the mount, not only the approval's: the `actionUrl` contract is "the inbox row's call-to-action", a Console route (`actionUrlFor` synthesises `/{object}/{id}` the same way), so this is the same fix for any topic a recipient routes to Slack.

## Verification

Live, on a real `pnpm dev -- --fresh` showcase boot (`OS_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:PORT`) with a Slack Web API sink preloaded (a `--import` module that answers `https://slack.com/api/*` locally and records each `chat.postMessage` payload): admin installs Slack (`PUT /api/v1/messaging/slack/account`), proposes and confirms their own link, then retitles a `showcase_announcement`, which starts `showcase_dynamic_approval` and sends the approval DM to the admin (org owner).

<details><summary>Captured DM text, before / after</summary>

- Before (origin/main source of `service-messaging`, rebuilt): the title "Approval requested" linked to `http://localhost:42375/system/approvals?request=areq_22f4a2e3-…` — on that boot `GET /system/approvals?request=x` answers `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.
- After (this branch): the title "Approval requested" linked to `http://localhost:42051/_console/system/approvals?request=areq_3363946e-…` — `GET /_console/system/approvals?request=x` is the Console mount (it answered `503 "The ObjectStack Console is not built…"` only because this container has no Console dist; with a built Console it serves the SPA route).

</details>

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/slack-channel.test.ts` — expect the "deep link under the Console mount" block green, the first case asserting `https://os.example.com/_console/system/approvals?request=r1`.

Read first: `packages/services/service-messaging/src/slack-channel.ts` (`consoleLinkBase` and the `send` line), then `messaging-service-plugin.ts` (the `getConsoleUrl` reader).
